rationale: Pickup equals max_load_current_a times load_margin_multiplier (420*1.2 = 504 A), giving sensitivity 1800/504 = 3.571 and secondary pickup 5.04 A within the 1-10 A relay range. Time delay equals downstream_time_delay_s plus selectivity_margin_s (0.35+0.30 = 0.65 s), within the 0-2 s range.
